scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the Saturday HarborBox heated-locker move-in usable for temporary cushion storage during the varnish weekend.
Emerging Need: The move has not started, but the assigned unit will not generate a gate code unless proof of outside insurance is on file before activation closes.
Decision Context: Notices, hold, calendar, and helper availability establish assignment, timing, and consequences; the budget workpad holds the declaration details, accepted intake address, and no-facility-protection preference.
Consequence: While activation remains open, supplying the prerequisite preserves the planned move-in without a new paid protection plan; after the batch closes, the same proof cannot make Saturday access available.

parameter.subject: Waitlist update for heated locker request
parameter.body: Your request for a 4x4 heated locker remains on the Tacoma waitlist. Insurance certificates are accepted only after a unit is assigned; unassigned documents are discarded by the intake system. If an offer opens, activation will require outside-insurance proof on file or a facility-protection selection before a gate code can be generated.

parameter.description: Pending refundable hold for HarborBox locker assignment HB-4C; completion depends on move-in activation.

parameter.title: Move cushions to HarborBox locker
parameter.description: Confirmed move-in appointment for assigned heated locker HB-4C at HarborBox Tacoma. Gate code issued after document activation.
parameter.location: HarborBox Tacoma Storage, Dock Street entrance

parameter.subject: Unit HB-4C activation status
parameter.body: Unit HB-4C is assigned for the January 31 move-in appointment. The outside-insurance declaration field is blank. The gate-code batch closes January 29 at 4:00 PM Pacific; units without proof of outside coverage or a facility-protection selection at that time remain inactive for weekend access.

parameter.content: I can still help haul the cushions Saturday morning, but only if the HarborBox gate code works. I cannot get to their office Friday afternoon to sort paperwork at the counter.

parameter.subject: Unit HB-4C weekend access not activated
parameter.body: The 4:00 PM activation batch closed with no outside-insurance declaration on unit HB-4C and no facility-protection selection. The January 31 gate code will not be generated. Counter activation resumes Monday morning for later access.
